reason: Conversation 1 wasted a turn re-asking facts the homeowner had already given, then gave up entirely with a canned 'can't diagnose, see an engineer' reply, offering no useful next step and never asking about the flash pattern or full model number. Conversation 2 over-commits to the drain pump as 'the most likely faulty component' (an unsupported claim given the genuine pump/pressure-switch/board ambiguity) and also never asked about the light-flash code, but it hedges that wiring and control 'cannot be ruled out', explicitly says an engineer should check before any pump is fitted, respects her refusal to remove panels, and gives a safe, unplugged, through-the-filter impeller check before escalating to an engineer. Neither recommended buying a part and neither had a safety lapse, so Conversation 2's practical, correctly bounded help edges out Conversation 1's honest but empty non-answer.
